$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：貪狼獨坐子午，《深造講義》p.53。

rules.text: 你的貪狼化忌，又見鈴星或陀羅：欲望偏低，甚至畏懼競爭，一碰到阻力就退縮。
rules.en: Your Tan Lang is transformed by Ji and meets Ling Xing or Tuo Luo: desire runs low, you may even shy away from competition, and you back off at the first obstacle.

source.quote: 甚至可以变成畏惧竞争，一碰到阻力便退缩

rules.text: 欲望偏淡不等於不好：只要不沉溺於嗜好，遇到奮發圖強的時機，你一樣有所作為。
rules.en: Light desire isn't a bad thing: as long as you don't sink into indulgence, when a time for striving comes, you can still achieve a great deal.

source.quote: 倘若不沉溺于不良嗜好，逢奋发图强的大运，仍然有所为

rules.text: 你的貪狼化權，欲望偏向物欲：人生觀積極，但過了頭，容易不擇手段，或者沉迷投機。
rules.en: Your Tan Lang is transformed by Quan, so desire leans towards the material: your outlook is active, but taken too far it can turn ruthless or drift into speculation.

source.quote: 但却可能发展成为不择手段的人
